name: aastal-monorepo
description: Build orchestration for the Aastal Electron desktop app. Backend folder: dentalDB-backend. Frontend folder: dentaldb. Not used for the web deployment, which builds those independently as before.

scripts.electron:install: npm install --prefix dentalDB-backend && npm install --prefix dentaldb && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.electron:stage-backend: rm -rf electron/.staging/backend && mkdir -p electron/.staging/backend && cp -r dentalDB-backend/dist dentalDB-backend/package.json dentalDB-backend/package-lock.json electron/.staging/backend/ && npm install --prefix electron/.staging/backend --omit=dev
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:build:backend && npm run electron:build:frontend && npm run electron:stage-backend && npm run electron:rebuild-native
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && npm run --prefix electron start
scripts.electron:dist: npm run electron:build && npm run --prefix electron dist
